mission: Deliver #257 (SNKRDUNK seed priority, owner 'go perfectionist' 2026-11-02). #257 merged at 2026-11-02 03:33Z (8dfe44ba) inside the 02:00-06:00 UTC busy window, so deploy_staging_collectors refused the forward rollout before reading Railway or uploading anything ('Collector release refused: could overlap the 02:00-06:00 UTC busy window'); snkrdunk-collector still runs its f65a7acc image. STAGING_DELIVERY.md's recovery for merged code with no rollout: a follow-up PR that touches no collector watch path and re-requests the same sequential release. This one changes one documentation line and requests the snkrdunk-collector rollout of its own merge commit, which carries #257's code.

impacts.reason: Item 3 records the refused rollout. Infrastructure: mission-scoped re-upload of snkrdunk-collector on this merge commit (code from #257, unchanged since its review).

routes: No new route; discovery requests stay inside the existing intent bounds and the dispatch budget
impact.deployment_impact: snkrdunk-collector re-uploaded on the merge commit with automatic rollback; must start between 06:00 and 23:00 UTC.

recovery.procedure: The rollout captures snkrdunk-collector's live deployment before upload and restores it on failure (recovery_deployment_id is reference only, carried from #252's mission); afterwards collector-redeploy to the fleet pin. Code: native revert PR with its own mission file.
recovery.trigger: Discovery intents failing on the new code, a source denial, or an intent with seed_anchors 0 while unspent seeds remain.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema change and no row written by this PR.

verification.observation_window: Delivery verify (SNKRDUNK component at the merge); then the next auto intent shows seed_anchors > 0 and inspected > 0 in snkrdunk-discovery-state.
